title: 第15章 双双觉醒天赋第16章 规则降临
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: “这是？丧尸犬！”
一头体型庞大，只有一只耳朵的黑色泰迪从街道巷子中缓缓走出。
“天呐，这还是泰迪吗？”陈静儿惊呼。
眼前的泰迪失去了一只耳朵，身躯有一匹马那般庞大。
它的眼球是灰白色，看上去诡异而恐怖。
又一声传来。
一头稍小一些，但个头也有大狼狗那般大的泰迪出现在一旁，虎视眈眈。
它们对着几人龇牙，猩红的血液还从嘴角流淌，缓缓滴落。
“大的那只至少是8级的，小的那只至少5级。”
林羽看着丧尸泰迪的体型和气势，微微一凛。
8级的话，四维属性基本都达到了45点，对付起来还是有些难度的。
“你们三个对付小的那只，尽全力！”林羽嘱咐一句，紧盯着大泰迪。
丧尸狗同时嘶吼，後腿一蹬，快速扑来，速度奇快。
林羽身上红色火焰出现，笼罩周身，整个人全部包裹在火焰之中。
恐怖的气势升腾而起。
“超级赛亚人？”
刘宇看到林羽变身，眼珠子都瞪出来了。
林羽现在的状态，可不就是和超级赛亚人很像嘛？
火焰包裹全身，如同火焰神祇。
这瞬间，林羽感受到了力量的暴涨。
156点的力量提升2倍后，直接暴涨到了468。
论力量，比一阶进化≈x4b7e;还要恐怖，堪堪能达到二阶的程度了。
同时。
他的魔力也在以每秒2点的速度快速消耗。
这意味着他8600的魔力，也只能支持他火焰覆盖全身一个小时左右。
一旦魔力消耗一空，就再也无法使用天赋异能了。
一拳轰出，和泰迪的狗爪撞击在一起。
瞬间，大泰迪身形倒飞出去，根本扛不住林羽的拳头。
恐怖的力量直接砸断了它的前腿，上面还在滋滋冒火。
接着，他抬手就是一片火焰席卷而过。
然而，丧尸狗的速度也很快，喷射而出的火焰很难击中它。
content_en:
"This is it? Zombie dog!"
A huge black teddy with only one ear slowly walked out of the street and alley.
"Oh my god, is this still Teddy?" Chen Jing'er exclaimed.
The Teddy in front of him was missing one of his ears and his body was as big as a horse.
Its eyeballs are gray-white and look weird and terrifying.
"Hiss!"
Another sound came.
A slightly smaller Teddy, but as big as a large wolfdog, appeared beside him and stared at him eagerly.
They bared their teeth at several people, and scarlet blood was still flowing from the corners of their mouths, slowly dripping.
"The big one is at least level 8, and the small one is at least level 5."
Lin Yu was slightly shuddered when he looked at the size and momentum of the zombie Teddy.
At level 8, the four-dimensional attributes basically reach 45 points, which is still a bit difficult to deal with.
"You three, try your best to deal with the little one!" Lin Yu ordered, staring closely at the big Teddy.
"Hiss~"
The zombie dogs roared at the same time, kicked off their hind legs, and rushed towards them at an extremely fast speed.
"Boom!"
Red flames appeared on Lin Yu's body, covering his whole body, and his whole person was wrapped in flames.
A terrifying momentum rose.
"Super Saiyan?"
Liu Yu's eyes popped out when he saw Lin Yu transform.
Isn't Lin Yu's current state very similar to a Super Saiyan?
Flames wrapped around his body, like a fire god.
At this moment, Lin Yu felt a surge in power.
After the power of 156 points was doubled, it skyrocketed to 468.
In terms of power, it is even more terrifying than the first level of evolution, and can almost reach the level of the second level.
at the same time.
His magic power is also being consumed rapidly at a rate of 2 points per second.
This means that his 8600 magic power can only support his body being covered in flames for about an hour.
Once the magic power is exhausted, the innate abilities can no longer be used.
"Boom"
The punch flew out and collided with Teddy's dog paw.
In an instant, the big teddy flew backwards, unable to withstand Lin Yu's fist.
The terrifying force directly broke its front legs, which were still burning.
Then, he raised his hand and a flame swept through him.
However, the zombie dog is also very fast, and it is difficult to hit it with the flames it sprays.
